newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Transnet posts loss in year to March 31.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Transnet posts loss in year to March 31.

text.p: NOTE - Transnet is South Africa's transport parastatal.

The group said the loss reflected provisions for post-retirement benefits amounting to 1,390 million rand against 1,387 the previous year. In addition, other operating costs exceeded budget because of an increase in aircraft landing and fuel costs, mainly due to the weakening of the rand, coupled with an increase in labour and general maintenance costs.
Transnet subsidiaries include South African Airways, Autonet (raod transport), Petronet (oil pipeline), Spoornet (railways), PX (container and parcel delivery) and Portnet (ports).
The government recently announced that it had earmarked transport as the second sector to be assessed for privatisation after telecommunications.
